mainText: <speak><voice name="Kimberly">Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a pleasant 72 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Harriet Park, and we have a full moon gracing us this evening.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Salli">The city has launched the I Voted sticker contest where residents can vote online through August 7 to pick designs from four student grade categories for the November election.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Ivy">Tonight is a great night for trivia with events happening today at both Hop Haus Brewing and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by tomorrow's farmer's market in downtown Verona.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Joanna">In our weekly police report, on July 26, a 55-year-old Stoughton woman was arrested for an O W I after being clocked at 97 miles per hour on the highway.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joey">Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, and tomorrow you can look forward to the Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor.</voice></speak>
